## KaliScriber 0.3.8

Install the `arm64-v8a` APK on most phones (`universal` if unsure). It updates over earlier builds and keeps your meetings and settings.

### Text-to-speech engines
- **Third-party engines now work.** The app couldn't see text-to-speech apps such as NekoSpeak or RHVoice, so it could only use a voice built into the phone. Phones without Google's voice, like GrapheneOS, had no voice at all. The app now declares that it looks for these engines, so Android shows them to it.
- **Choose the engine in Settings.** Under the voice setting, pick **Phone voice engine**: the system default, or any installed engine. If the chosen engine doesn't start, the app tries the others.
- **Test voice** in Settings reads a sample sentence, or shows why the voice couldn't speak.
